claim: Unreferenced decoy Reviewer evidence could hide a same-session or same-model role collision.
evidence: All PASS Reviewer/Challenger records now participate in session/model set checks.
Producer, Reviewer, and Challenger model equality is rejected.
impact: A non-independent review pair could satisfy an independent gate.
required_action: Require disjoint Reviewer/Challenger session and model sets and reject producer collisions.

prevention.action: L3 provenance validation checks every final-version PASS host context and disjoint role sets.
